turns.user: I have a Budapest pass. Can I get the cheaper ticket for bus 100E?
turns.agent:
Possibly—it depends on the exact pass. As of the 5 November 2026 snapshot, the reduced 1,000 HUF 100E add-on is available with a valid qualifying Budapest pass, but the 15-day Budapest pass and the monthly pass for job seekers are excluded. The add-on covers one trip on 100E only. (BKK: Add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket)

Which exact Budapest pass do you have? The pass name is enough; I can assess whether the snapshot says it qualifies. The full-price 100E ticket in that snapshot is 2,500 HUF. (BKK: Airport shuttle bus single ticket)

This is educational guidance, not live verification; check BKK’s current rules before travelling.
